_comment: Real-classifier test manifest: 11 labeled UI screens from EXPERIMENT-01 §1.2 (3 broadcast promos and 1 black-frame excluded — broadcast = playback's job, black = capture-side). This is the COMPLEMENT of the existing test_localize_regression.py manifest (which mocks matcher + Tier 2): here the test calls the REAL ImageHelpers.identify_screen + scv.screen_state + scv.error, with a STUB node_fps set loaded from tests/localize/fixtures/*.json (the goal is to test the payload plumbing, not the matcher quality). The 11 userinterfaces come from the table in EXPERIMENT-01-onejev-abstain-coverage.md:39-43. Source paths follow the cold-archive convention: /Users/Shared/vpt_captures/<host>_<captureN>/capture_<NNNNNN>.jpg. Unreachable rows are SKIPPED with a warning, not failed (per the task spec). No real brand names (AGENTS.md leak-gate).

rows.note: EXPERIMENT-01 row 1: Switch HOME menu (frozen, 174 of 200 frames in pi3 widened capture2). UI is settled, no overlay, no error dialog, no playback. company=NULL on switch.
EXPERIMENT-01 row 2: Switch HOME menu with focused tile highlight (mid-archive). Same screen, focus ring does not change the page. UI is settled, no overlay.
EXPERIMENT-01 row 3: Switch game title screen (mid-archive, slot ~1000). Settled UI; no playback, no error.
EXPERIMENT-01 row 4: Switch in-game cutscene A. Treat as a settled game surface; not a video. Playback is_media is not wired in the standalone monitor, so 'not_applicable' regardless.
EXPERIMENT-01 row 5: Switch in-game cutscene B (mid-archive). Same surface logic as cutscene A.
EXPERIMENT-01 row 6: Switch in-game cutscene C (mid-archive). Same surface logic.
EXPERIMENT-01 row 7: Switch in-game cutscene D (mid-archive). Same surface logic.

EXPERIMENT-01 row 8: Switch error dialog A — a raised plate over a dimmed backdrop (the geometry screen_state_cv.overlay already tests). Error arm 'visible' is the optimistic case (no OCR tokens here, so it depends on the cascade's no-keyword behaviour). NOTE: with no real error tokens, the cascade returns 'unknown' on real runs — see the per-frame diff in results/real_match_11.json for the actual answer.
EXPERIMENT-01 row 9: Switch error dialog B — same surface as A.
EXPERIMENT-01 row 10: 2048 web game page (pi1 capture1, first frame). Settled browser game, no overlay, no playback (game is canvas-driven, not a video surface).

EXPERIMENT-01 row 11: Android quick-settings shade (pi1 capture1, mid-archive). A system overlay surface; Tier-2 overlay='none' because the shade IS the foreground, not an overlay on something else. (EXPERIMENT-01 §1.1 frames it as uncaptured, not unidentified.)
